name: Bulk modify contacts list
description: Call this when you need to apply a bulk action (e.g., delete contacts from a list) to a set of contacts selected in the UI. Use the single‑contact endpoint (the action that removes a single contact from a list) when you only need to modify one contact, as it is more appropriate for that case.
preconditions: The list(s) referenced in the request must already exist.

action.description: The bulk action to perform. Currently supported: DELETE_FROM_LIST.

is_all_selected.description: Whether the action applies to all contacts matching the filter, ignoring the explicit ids array.

ids.description: Array of contact IDs to which the action should be applied when is_all_selected is false.

fe_query.description: Frontend query object describing additional filter criteria for selecting contacts.

searchBy.description: Free‑text search term used in the UI to narrow the contact set.

unlink_list_ids.description: List IDs from which the contacts should be removed.

message.description: Confirmation that the bulk process has been dispatched.

side_effects: The specified contacts are removed from the given list(s).
